question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus these SDK token-budget helpers as the stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold the token-budget signal into the broader assemble metadata RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: This is a public plugin API and SDK export surface, and the related RFC is still open on the same assemble contract boundary.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve the optional `currentTokenCount` contract now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted real-behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into RFC
options.body: Pause or close this branch and handle token counts together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Private For Now
options.body: Avoid new SDK exports until maintainers settle the permanent plugin API shape and compatibility expectations.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve the optional `currentTokenCount` contract now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted real-behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently merged the closest context-engine assembly budgeting work and are assigned on this PR.
